title: timeline: every past date is bucketed "Overdue", including creation dates and Done records
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — timeline views | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), item 3. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx` (`dateBucket`, about `:753`) and its translation keys ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the bucket labels a date overdue without knowing what the date means.

## What happens

Showcase → Authoring · Visualizations → Activity Timeline (`startDateField: 'created_at'`) puts all 10 tasks under "OVERDUE 10", the two `Done` ones included. `dateBucket` returns `timeline.bucket.overdue` for any `ts < today`. A creation date cannot be overdue.

## Done when

- Past dates get a neutral bucket (for example "Earlier"), unless the field is a due or end date and the record is not closed.
- The dev reads which signal the timeline config already carries (a due-date role, an end field, or a status) and uses it. ⛔ Field names are not guessed.
- The new bucket label is translated in every locale.
- **Pins:** a `created_at` timeline shows no "Overdue", and a due-date timeline still marks an open past-due record as overdue but not a closed one.
